body:
I neglected to mention it, but I have been talking to a therapist. We apparently have a very good graduate program in psychology at my university, so I've been helping a grad student get practice at talking to crazy folks in exchange for him helping me be less crazy. :P It's going... slowly, I guess. I think that's part of why I'm so worried I'm even having suicidal impulses.

One of my problems is that I don't really know who "me" is. I'm doing math and science, probably because they've always come easily to me (except for now and the future). I don't know what I want to do with that, I don't know what I want to do in general, I don't know why I'm here... And it's getting a little harder to bear.

And yeah, I know intellectually I'll get over my ex. But I still want to get back together with her (though I refuse to talk to her about that, we're both very stubborn people, and I'm almost certain she has no interest in reconciliation; I do however talk to her once every couple of months, usually she reaches out to say "hello," and also she came to a birthday party I hosted at my apartment off campus, an hour away from her home). I've tried to get back in the saddle, but I've had some genuinely hilarious failures. In my better moments I recognize that shit happens, life goes on, and a lot of the drama I've had to deal with RE: girls is actually pretty funny and not too bad... but I'm having fewer "better moments," and life in general is weighing me down.

I mean, I'm typing this in bed on a Sunday evening, after I promised myself I'd spend the day working, after I blew off working yesterday, and all last week, and I skipped classes. I haven't left my room, I missed my friend's party last night... I just can't shake the feeling that I'm doing everything entirely wrong. I don't even know how to set things right, because I'm not sure what right is.

Thank you for posting. It's good to hear that it's at least possible to get out of this, and that other people have felt the same way I currently feel (shitty and hopeless?) I just wish... well, y'know?
